Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter, now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6003adhPz

Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner. 

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of the kingdom, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

Well Dweller – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch
Play Well Dweller now on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6004adh68

At the bottom of this well lives the only creature brave enough to challenge the queen.  

Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale Metroidvania full of charming characters! As Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a matchstick, set off on a journey through a wretched kingdom, where you must burn the wicked queen to save your family.
